settings.question: WHERE ARE YOUR ITEMS MADE?
settings.answer: Our products are made in Nigeria.

settings.question: IS THIS A WOMEN OWNED BUSINESS?
settings.answer: Yes, and we are proud!

settings.question: IS THIS A BLACK OWNED BUSINESS?
settings.answer: Certainly, we are well-diversified in our business.

settings.question: ARE YOU A SUSTAINABLE BRAND? WHAT ARE YOUR ETHICS?
settings.answer: Our handmade pieces are crafted using ethically sourced materials obtained through fair-trade practices, ensuring minimal impact on the environment throughout our production, processing, shipping, and logistics chain. The fabrics we use are meticulously manufactured using age-old processes, predominantly by hand, and occasionally employing centuries-old dyeing and staining techniques.

settings.question: CAN I WEAR YOUR BEAUTIFUL DRESSES? WILL IT BE CULTURALLY APPROPRIATE?
settings.answer: Our clothes are made to make every woman confident, beautiful and attractive regardless of age, size, race or nationality. We embrace everyone and we are proud and privileged to serve women all over the world thus integrating our African culture/fabrics with the western style through our gorgeous pieces.

settings.question: WHERE DO YOU SHIP FROM?
settings.answer: We ship from Northern Ireland, United Kingdom.

settings.question: ARE THERE EXTRA CUSTOM CHARGES FOR EU CUSTOMERS?
settings.answer:
No, there are no extra customs charges for some EU customs as we ship from Northern Ireland. However, some countries in the EU might request that you pay for customs. Please check with the customs of your country.

Again, ensure to check with your country should there be any charges.

settings.question: DO YOU SHIP TO MY COUNTRY?
settings.answer: Yes, we ship worldwide. Shipping costs differ from country to country. Please see question below for more details on this.

settings.question: DO YOU OFFER EXPRESS SHIPPING?
settings.answer:
We provide express shipping to all customers across various countries.

However, if you're requesting express shipping within the UK, please note that immediate 24-hour shipping after 1pm is not available. Kindly wait until the next day for your order to be shipped out. Thank you for your understanding!

settings.question: USA CUSTOMERS: DO I HAVE TO PAY EXTRA FEES OR TARIFFS WHEN MY ORDER ARRIVES?
settings.answer: No. We cover all tariffs and customs fees for US customers. What you see at checkout is exactly what you pay.

settings.question: CAN I CHANGE OR MODIFY MY SHIPPING ADDRESS?
settings.answer: Yes. You can change your address before the order is sent. Please send an email to heritageclothingstore@gmail.com

settings.question: CAN I GET A REFUND OR RESHIPMENT ON MY STOLEN ITEMS?
settings.answer: To address the potential risk of theft, we kindly request customers to indicate their preference for a signed delivery by sending an email or including a note with their order. This proactive measure allows us to make necessary arrangements before dispatching items, ensuring your valuable shipments are safeguarded throughout the journey. Please note that failure to adhere to this procedure may result in the absence of a refund or replacement in the event of theft.

settings.question: WILL I GET A CONFIRMATION EMAIL AFTER I HAVE MADE AN ORDER?
settings.answer: Yes, you will, if you do not get it in your main email, please check your spam folder. Sometimes, confirmation messages are sent via SMS.

settings.question: HOW DO I TRACK MY ORDER?
settings.answer:
We will always send tracking information once an order is processed.

All express orders are sent via DHL, your tracking number will be 10 digits with no letters. To track via DHL press here: https://parcel.dhl.co.uk/track-a-parcel/

For standard deliveries, orders are sent via Royal mail. Your tracking number will be in this format, LO06746540GB. To track via Royal mail please press here: https://www.royalmail.com/track-your-item

All UK orders are sent via Royal mail - 24 hours tracked service. No signature required. (Should you need a signed for items, please reach out to us on heritageclothingstore@gmail.com)

settings.question: USA: HOW LONG WILL IT TAKE TO RECEIVE MY ORDER?
settings.answer: Your order will be at your doorstep within 5 to 8 working days.

settings.question: WHAT HAPPENS IF I INPUT AN INCORRECT ADDRESS ON MY ORDER?
settings.answer:
Once the item is sent out, we, unfortunately, cannot change the adjust the address.

Please reach out to us at heritageclothingstore@gmail.com. Please note that we are not liable for lost orders if the address on the orders is incorrect.

settings.question: CAN I CANCEL MY ORDER?
settings.answer: We cannot guarantee that your order will be canceled when the items are being fulfilled.

settings.question: WHAT HAPPENS TO DELAYED OR IF MY ORDER IS IN TRANSIT?
settings.answer: Please contact us at heritageclothing@gmail.com

settings.question: DO YOU ACCEPT CUSTOM ORDERS?
settings.answer: Yes, however, we only do customized orders in bulk (a minimum of 5 items).

settings.question: HOW CAN I CHANGE TO MY CURRENCY
settings.answer: Your currency will be automatically populated on our website or you can change the currency using the currency icon on the bottom right-hand side of the website.

settings.question: WHY DOES MY CURRENCY CHANGE AT CHECKOUT.
settings.answer: Our online store is registered and based in the UK. As a result, your location will be converted to pounds sterling at checkout. Please don't be alarmed by this adjustment. To ensure the correct amount is charged by your bank, we recommend using your currency converter to calculate the total. If you require further details or assistance, please feel free to contact us at heritageclothingstore@gmail.com.

settings.question: GIFTING AND GIFT-WRAPPING SERVICE.
settings.answer:
Available on request.

If you're interested in a gift card, please reach out to us, and we'll provide you with the offer you need.

settings.question: HOW DO I REDEEM MY POINTS?
settings.answer:
Create an account first. After your purchase(s), points will be automatically added to your account. You can then redeem them for rewards.

Follow the link to learn how to redeem your points >> Click Here

settings.question: CAN I GET A DISCOUNT CODE ON SALE ITEMS?
settings.answer: Unfortunately, not, unless we announce it.

settings.question: WHY DO I SEE PRICES IN POUNDS (£) AT CHECKOUT?
settings.answer: Our system currently displays prices in GBP at checkout. Your bank will convert it to dollars or your currency for you. You can use the currency converter on the website or reach out to us for any clarifications on currency conversions.
